_source: RFC 9421 appendix B.1.4 (example Ed25519 key) and B.2.6 (signing a request using ed25519), extracted mechanically. The backslashes of RFC 8792 line wrapping are already removed, and the base ends WITHOUT a trailing newline, per the ABNF of section 2.5: signature-base = *( signature-base-line LF ) signature-params-line.
_note: B.2.6 is the only appendix example that is both Ed25519 and deterministic, so it is the one that can be compared byte for byte. It pins three things at once: the covered component list, the character-for-character shape of the signature base, and the base64 (padded, unlike the unpadded base64url of a thumbprint) encoding of the signature.
signature_base:
"date": Tue, 20 Apr 2021 02:07:55 GMT
"@method": POST
"@path": /foo
"@authority": example.com
"content-type": application/json
"content-length": 18
"@signature-params": ("date" "@method" "@path" "@authority" "content-type" "content-length");created=1618884473;keyid="test-key-ed25519"
